camel_example: aliyun iot ReBindLicenseDevice --region cn-hangzhou --LicenseCode LINK_SPEECH_COMMON_LICENSE --DeviceNameList.1 testdevice --ProductKey a2YwD23000
description_en: Re-authorizes a license for devices under a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品下设备重新授权License
kebab_example: aliyun iot re-bind-license-device --license-code LINK_SPEECH_COMMON_LICENSE --product-key a2YwD23000 --device-name-list testdevice --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReBindLicenseDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
For new Enterprise instances or Enterprise Edition instances, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
For legacy Enterprise instances that do not have IDs, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
对于新版公共实例或企业版实例，实例有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
对于旧版公共实例，实例无ID值，无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The license type. Currently, only Qianli Chuanyin is supported. Valid values: LINK_SPEECH_COMMON_LICENSE
parameters.help_zh: License类型，暂时只支持千里传音，可取值：LINK_SPEECH_COMMON_LICENSE
parameters.name: license_code

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the devices belong.

You can view the information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
待授权设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of devices to which you want to re-authorize the license. Specify the deviceName of each device.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query the DeviceName of all devices under a specified product
parameters.help_zh:
待授权License的设备列表，需传入设备对应的deviceName。

您可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html，查询指定产品下所有设备的**DeviceName**
parameters.name: device_name_list

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The result of the re-authorization operation

CheckProgressId.description_en: The unique ID used to query the progress of the batch device authorization
CheckProgressId.description_zh: 查询批量授权设备进度的唯一ID

FailSum.description_en: The number of devices for which the license authorization failed

Progress.description_en: The progress percentage of the batch license authorization for devices. Valid values: 1 to 100
Progress.description_zh: 为批量设备授权License的进度百分比，即取值范围为1~100

ResultCsvFile.description_en: The URL of the file that contains the devices for which the license re-authorization failed
ResultCsvFile.description_zh: 重新授权License完成后，授权失败设备文件的URL

SuccessSum.description_en: The number of devices for which the license was successfully re-authorized
SuccessSum.description_zh: 重新授权License成功的设备个数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: An internal error occurred. Try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
